exposure: occurrence of premature rupture of membranes (PROM)
cohort: The study included placental samples from 118 late pregnant women.
finding: Bax and Bcl-2 expressions in late pregnancy placentas were associated with the onset of parturient status and PROM, and their combined prediction accurately predicted PROM.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery (pre-term, term, or post-term).
gest_age: Pre-term, term, and post-term gestational ages.
